$comment: Permissions for the headless AI runs this app spawns — NOT for interactive Claude
Code sessions in this repo. Passed with --settings; see lib/ai/claude-cli.ts.
VERIFIED BEHAVIOUR on CLI 2.1.235, tested rather than assumed:
* `deny` rules here ARE enforced. A run told to write vault/ is blocked; the same
run without these rules writes it. That test is what makes this file meaningful.
* `allow` rules here are NOT honoured. A run with only an allow entry for the run
directory was still denied, so path-scoped ALLOW is not available.
* `--allowedTools` accepts bare tool names only. `Write(.groundwork/runs/**)` is
not parsed as a scoped rule there either.
Consequence: Write is granted broadly by the flag, and scoping is achieved by denying
everything the run has no business touching. Deny beats allow, so this is a real
boundary — but it is a denylist, which means a NEW top-level directory holding source
must be added here. Re-check this file if the CLI major version changes.
